## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for locations that border one another; symmetric.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for traversable connection (use [`gmeow:spatiallyConnectsTo`](gmeow-spatiallyConnectsTo.md)) and for containment ([`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md)); RCC-8 EC ([`gmeow:rcc8ec`](gmeow-rcc8ec.md)) is the precise touching relation.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:adjacentTo`](gmeow-adjacentTo.md) between Locations; for precise mereotopology use the RCC-8 relations.
